Deq shapes as typed, tree-shakable Vue 3 components.

```vue
<script setup>
import { RojHalfSun, DeqIcon } from "@0xdolan/deq-vue";
</script>
<template>
  <RojHalfSun :size="32" :stroke-width="1.5" absolute-stroke-width />
  <DeqIcon name="kurdish-sun" color="#ED2024" />
</template>
```

Source: [`packages/vue`](../../packages/vue/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-vue`.

## Per-shape exports

93 generated exports, one per shape, such as `ArchDot`, `ArchDotColumn`, `ArrowDown`. The [icon list](https://kanilabs.github.io/deq/icons/) shows every shape.

## Functions

### `createDeqIcon`

```ts
function createDeqIcon(icon: DeqIcon, name: string): DeqIconComponent
```

Make a typed component from icon data (`@0xdolan/deq-icons`). The generated components
use this; call it yourself for custom icon data.

## Constants

### `DeqIcon`

```ts
const DeqIcon: DefineComponent<ExtractPropTypes<{ size: { readonly type: PropType<string | number>; readonly default: undefined; }; color: { readonly type: StringConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; strokeWidth: { readonly type: PropType<string | number>; readonly default: undefined; }; absoluteStrokeWidth: { readonly type: BooleanConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; title: { readonly type: StringConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; name: { type: StringConstructor; required: true; }; }>, () => VNode<RendererNode, RendererElement, { [key: string]: any; }>, {}, {}, {}, ComponentOptionsMixin, ComponentOptionsMixin, {}, string, PublicProps, ToResolvedProps<ExtractPropTypes<{ size: { readonly type: PropType<string | number>; readonly default: undefined; }; color: { readonly type: StringConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; strokeWidth: { readonly type: PropType<string | number>; readonly default: undefined; }; absoluteStrokeWidth: { readonly type: BooleanConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; title: { readonly type: StringConstructor; readonly default: undefined; }; name: { type: StringConstructor; required: true; }; }>, {}>, { size: string | number; color: string; strokeWidth: string | number; absoluteStrokeWidth: boolean; title: string; }, {}, {}, {}, string, ComponentProvideOptions, true, {}, any>
```

Any icon by catalog id: `<DeqIcon name="roj-half-sun" />`. It keeps every icon in the
bundle; import the named components (`RojHalfSun`) to tree-shake.

**@throws** {DeqError} `UNKNOWN_SHAPE` for an id that is not in the catalog.

### `packageName`

```ts
const packageName: '@0xdolan/deq-vue'
```

The npm package name.

## Types

### `DeqIconComponent`

```ts
type DeqIconComponent = DefineComponent<typeof iconProps>
```

A Deq icon component: the props of `DeqIconProps`, plus a default slot.

### `DeqIconProps`

```ts
type DeqIconProps = IconOptions
```

Props of every Deq icon component; other attributes fall through to the `<svg>`.
